content.trans: 我知道听起来很奇怪，但401(k)是一种允许员工的退休储蓄计划。

content.text: save and invest for their own retirement.
content.trans: 为自己的退休储蓄和投资。

content.text: Through a 401k, you can authorize your employer to deduct a certain amount of money from your
content.trans: 通过401(k)，你可以授权你的雇主从你的账户中扣除一定金额的款项。

content.text: paycheck and invest it in the 401k plan.
content.trans: 薪水存入401k计划。

content.text: Everyone tries to contribute as much as possible so that when you retire, you can rest peacefully
content.trans: 每个人都尽力贡献，这样当你退休时，你可以平静地休息。

content.text: on your nest egg.
content.trans: 你的积蓄。

content.text: It's interesting and logical, I guess.
content.trans: 我觉得挺有趣也很合逻辑的。

content.text: In my country, we also have to contribute to a government-run retirement fund, but most
content.trans: 在我们国家，我们也必须为政府管理的退休金做出贡献，但大多数情况下。

content.text: people don't really trust it so they just invest in properties or things like that.
content.trans: 人们并不真正信任它，所以他们就投资房产或其他类似的东西。

content.text: That seems a bit unstable, don't you think?
content.trans: 你是不是觉得有点不稳定？

content.text: Yeah, but corrupt governments in the past have created distrust among banks and financial
content.trans: 是的，但过去的腐败政府已经导致银行和金融机构之间产生了不信任。

content.text: institutions.
content.trans: 机构

content.text: So now people prefer to have money hidden in a jar or a piggy bank.
content.trans: 所以现在人们更喜欢把钱藏在罐子里或存钱罐里。

content.text: I've been thinking of doing that lately.
content.trans: 我最近一直在考虑做那个。

content.text: I don't want some banker to run off with my money.
content.trans: 我不希望有人拿着我的钱跑路。

content.text: All right, we're back.
content.trans: 好的，我们回来了。

content.text: So this whole savings thing, are you good at saving?
content.trans: 所以，这个存钱这件事，你擅长吗？

content.text: Do you have your nest egg planned out for your retirement?
content.trans: 你有没有为退休攒够了钱？

content.text: Nest egg, no, but I'm a compulsive saver.
content.trans: 储蓄罐，不，但我是个强迫症的储户。

content.text: Really?
content.trans: 真的？

content.text: To save a lot.
content.trans: 为了节省很多。

content.text: Oh, wow.
content.trans: 哦，哇。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: Because you never know when you're going to need money.
content.trans: 因为你永远不会知道你需要钱的时候是什么时候。

content.text: And I think once you get a kind of an adult job, the nine to five job, it's important
content.trans: 并且我认为，一旦你有了那种成人的工作，比如九点到五点的工作，那就很重要了

content.text: to spend as little as possible so that you can create a nest egg or some kind of savings
content.trans: 为了尽可能少地花费，以便能存下一笔钱或者做一些储蓄。

content.text: account for the future because it'd be nice to have a car or a house someday.
content.trans: 为了未来，因为有一天我希望拥有一辆汽车或房子。

content.text: Right, right.
content.trans: 好的，好的。

content.text: And also, as you say, unexpected things happen.
content.trans: 而且，正如你说的那样，意外的事情发生了。

content.text: So something may happen, maybe you break your arm and you don't have any savings or maybe
content.trans: 所以可能会发生什么，也许你摔断了胳膊，没有储蓄或者可能...

content.text: no insurance.
content.trans: 没有保险。

content.text: So at least you have some money stashed away where you can use it.
content.trans: 所以至少你还有些钱可以用来用。

content.text: Really?
content.trans: 真的？

content.text: And I know that in America right now in the news, the credit crisis is very popular to
content.trans: 而且我知道，現在在美國的報紙上，貨幣危機非常熱門。

content.text: talk about.
content.trans: 谈论

content.text: And so part of this economic situation is that people owe more money than they have.
content.trans: 因此，这个经济状况的一部分就是人们欠的钱比他们有的多。

content.text: That means they spent more money than they own.
content.trans: 这意味着他们比自己拥有的钱多花了。

content.text: And so they don't have any savings.
content.trans: 所以他们没有储蓄。

content.text: And that really scares me.
content.trans: 那真的很让我害怕。

content.text: So I think it's a really smart idea to start investing as soon as you can.
content.trans: 我认为从你开始能投资的时候就投资，这是一个非常聪明的想法。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 非常好。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Why is a financial advice from EnglishPod.com?
content.trans: 为什么来自英语通的财务建议？

content.text: Thank you.
content.trans: 谢谢。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 所有权利。

content.text: Any questions, any doubts or any more financial questions?
content.trans: 有任何问题、任何疑虑或关于财务的其他问题？

content.text: Please come to EnglishPod.com and we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 请来到英语有声网，我们会在那里见到你们。

content.text: Bye everyone.
content.trans: 再见大家。
